note: Reviewed evidence cards. A card states one thing in the game's own words and points to the sentence in the sourced book files it rests on. Status reviewed means the claim matches its source line. It does not mean anyone has checked the source independently. A card with check true needs that check before it is relied on.

cards.claim: The Party-state's National Intelligence Law of 2017 obliges any organization or citizen to support, assist and cooperate with state intelligence work.
cards.source: National Intelligence Law (2017), Article 7, and National Security Law (2015), Article 11, as cited in the Military-Civil Fusion case, note 4.

cards.claim: The Hong Kong national security law claims jurisdiction over offenses committed outside Hong Kong by non-residents, and the police later posted bounties on named activists abroad.
cards.source: National Security Law, Article 38, and Hong Kong Police Force bounty announcements of July and December 2023, as cited in the Hong Kong case, note 9.

cards.claim: The Party-state has run overseas police service stations on foreign soil to pressure dissidents.
cards.source: Justice Department complaints and arrests of 2023 and Safeguard Defenders reporting, as cited in Part Three, note 9.

cards.claim: The book argues that the statute puts the relatives of a person abroad within the Party-state's reach, so the relative becomes the lever.
cards.source: Military-Civil Fusion case, the passage on the National Intelligence Law. The book states this as its own argument.

cards.claim: The People's Bank of China designed its digital currency on a managed-anonymity principle, private for small purchases and traceable when the state decides it matters.
cards.source: People's Bank of China Digital Currency Research Institute publications on e-CNY design, as cited in the Financial Control case, note 4. The book says full integration with the behavioral record is not yet operational at national scale.

cards.claim: Authorities suspended the Ant Group listing on 3 November 2020, two days before it was to price.
cards.source: Shanghai Stock Exchange suspension of 3 November 2020 with the Hong Kong tranche following, as cited in the Financial Control case, note 1.

cards.claim: Hong Kong's Apple Daily published its final edition on 24 June 2021 after an asset freeze under the national security law.
cards.source: Apple Daily final edition, 24 June 2021, with asset-freeze figures from company filings and Security Bureau statements, as cited in the Hong Kong case, note 4.

cards.claim: About a quarter of China scholars report that they censor themselves.
cards.source: Greitens and Truex, Repressive Experiences among China Scholars, The China Quarterly (2020), as cited in Part Two, note 14.

cards.claim: In the West the same powers over money are divided and contested in public. Courts can challenge them, voters can answer them and a free press can report them. Anyone can escape them. In China they sit with a single party.
cards.source: Financial Control case, the passage on accountability. The book states this as its own argument.

cards.claim: In February 2022 Canada invoked its Emergencies Act and froze the bank accounts of people who had funded a protest. A Federal Court ruling in 2024 found the invocation unreasonable.
cards.source: Emergencies Act invocation of February 2022, the Public Order Emergency Commission and the 2024 Federal Court ruling, as cited in the Financial Control case, note 7.

cards.claim: From 2013 to 2017 a Justice Department initiative pressured banks to cut off legal but disfavored businesses. House findings and FDIC reversals followed.
cards.source: Operation Choke Point, a Justice Department initiative of 2013 to 2017, with House Oversight Committee findings and FDIC policy reversals, as cited in the Financial Control case, note 6.

cards.claim: In 2023 a British bank quietly debanked a political figure over his views. An apology, an executive's resignation and a regulatory review followed.
cards.source: The UK debanking episode of 2023 and the Financial Conduct Authority review, as cited in the Financial Control case, note 8.

cards.claim: Suspicion by ancestry is the outcome the Party wants. It isolates the diaspora and confirms the Party's claim that overseas Chinese have no home but the People's Republic.
cards.source: Military-Civil Fusion case, the closing passage on the defense. The book states this as its own argument.

cards.claim: The Defense Department's 1260H list of Chinese military companies and the Commerce Department's Entity List are published in the Federal Register.
cards.source: Section 1260H designations and Entity List determinations, as cited in the Military-Civil Fusion case, note 5.

cards.claim: Under the pressure of a delisting statute the PCAOB secured an inspection agreement in August 2022 and conducted its first inspections of mainland and Hong Kong audit firms in late 2022.
cards.source: PCAOB Statement of Protocol of August 2022, as cited in the Borrowed Knife case, note 3.

cards.claim: The book's counter to transnational repression is to treat it as a national-security offense and not a private dispute, to shut the overseas stations and to protect the diaspora plainly.
cards.source: Part Three, the Sign and the Counter for the Psychological domain. The book states this as its own counter.

cards.claim: The book's defense against a Phase operation is to stage the response before the trigger. Sanctions, asset actions and legal measures are designed and agreed in advance, so the answer lands in hours and not months.
cards.source: Hong Kong case, the passage on the counter. The book states this as its own counter.

cards.claim: The First Amendment bars the US government from suppressing lawful speech.
cards.source: United States Constitution, amendment I. A primary text and not from the book files.

cards.claim: US agencies compel a firm to produce customer data only through a warrant, a court order or a statutory process the firm can challenge in court.
cards.source: United States Constitution, amendment IV, and the Stored Communications Act. A primary text and not from the book files.
